secrets.description: Falling-sands canvas address. Users send drawing transactions here. Reuse the canonical falling-sands pubkey so this deploy converges on the same simulation state from chain history as the canonical examples deploy.
Optional admin pubkey - permitted to issue {"app":"falling-sands","type":"reset"} memos. Any reset from a different sender is silently ignored. Unset means no admin (the client hides reset UI).
Sidecar usernode RPC endpoint. Defaults to the in-network node service.

Set to 1 to bypass the explorer's 5-60s indexing lag and use the node's direct SSE stream + catch-up poll for live transactions. Requires the sidecar to expose /transactions/by_recipient + /transactions/stream. Defaults to 1.
On-disk snapshot directory the engine reads/writes. The snapshot-store hydrates it from Postgres on boot and mirrors writes back. Defaults to /app/data inside the container.

tests.name: App loads and WASM engine initializes (no console errors)
